text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple System Atrophy (MSA). The combination of cerebellar/gait ataxia, parkinsonism (rigidity, tremor), autonomic dysfunction (orthostatic hypotension, urinary incontinence), and MRI findings of brainstem and cerebellar atrophy is classic for MSA.
